brief:
为 Narciso Rodriguez Narciso Poudrée 制作高品质商业香水海报。保留上传商品原貌与可见标签；为这款商品形成四个真正不同的创意方向。只使用品牌与产品名称，不添加价格、容量、促销、新品或功效宣传。
本次必须采用以下独立艺术方向，优先于通用风格要求；保留用户商品、文案和禁止事项：把扑粉的下坠读作一张点刻画：平涂深橄榄 Moss 卡纸上，细密骨白粉点自顶带向下逐级稀薄如粉雾沉降，在下三分之一处被一道硬边留白横带截断，如同粉尘落定；一枚低不透明度橄榄矩形板沉于点场之后托住剪影下半，点阵从其肩后继续垂落却不触碰标签。商品沉于下幅立于点场心与留白带之前，奶油漆芯的柔体积对抗点密度的平面下坠。顶带留出完全安静的铭牌区：宽距 Arial 品牌字最小置顶，Bodoni 题名以近满幅宽的单行 Didone 大字居中统领，副行垫底，一条粉白细线横垫其下如沉降零点——题名整组结束于瓶顶之上，构成 ABOVE 纪念碑网格。无地面无 horizon，纯点密度叙事。参考 R1 的铭牌层级（品牌轻、题名重、副行垫底）、R4 的中心聚焦秩序与 R6 的柔光粉彩温度。

references.selection_reason: Highly resolved commercial perfume advertisement featuring dramatic floral explosion, strong contrast, and clear campaign typography.

analysis.composition: Asymmetrical balance with the faceted bottle anchored lower-left against an exploding rose, counterweighted by right-aligned typography in the negative space.
analysis.negative_space: Dark, textured void on the right utilized effectively for legible white text placement.
analysis.lighting: Dramatic studio lighting with high contrast; sharp specular highlights on the geometric glass facets and soft, directional light defining the rose petals.
analysis.typography: Clean, sans-serif and serif mix in white; prominent '007' logo lockup with supporting tagline and URL, distinctly separate from the product container.
analysis.information_density: Moderate; focuses on brand identity, product name, and evocative tagline without clutter.

references.selection_reason: Highly resolved digital still-life featuring a clear perfume subject with strong geometric background elements and cohesive amber palette; excellent reference for tech-forward fragrance visuals.

analysis.composition: Centered rectangular bottle framed by large, soft-focus circular gradients creating depth and focus.
analysis.negative_space: Dark, gradient periphery focusing attention on the illuminated center.
analysis.lighting: Backlit and internal glow emphasizing liquid color and glass transparency against a dark void.
analysis.typography: None outside the container; label text is part of the product packaging.
analysis.information_density: Low; purely visual focus on product and abstract atmosphere.

references.selection_reason: Professionally resolved perfume still-life with clear brand identity, high-quality lighting, and cohesive pastel color palette suitable for design reference.

analysis.composition: Clustered arrangement of four faceted glass bottles, three upright and one horizontal, creating depth and visual interest against a seamless background.
analysis.negative_space: Moderate negative space at the top and bottom, allowing the product cluster to dominate the frame while maintaining breathing room.
analysis.lighting: Soft, diffused studio lighting with gentle highlights on the glass facets and gold collars, creating a luminous and premium feel.
analysis.typography: Minimalist sans-serif lettering printed directly on the glass containers; no external campaign typography present.
analysis.information_density: Low to medium; focus is purely on the product aesthetics and color variation without distracting text overlays.
